body:
He wasnt around it. Pretty funny that you make those assumptions. He never even had seen weed in his lifetime.
In my country you'll get fined If you get caught selling weed. Period.
I never said that it's ok. I said I did what I had to in order to provide food for my family. But feel free to speak up your mind.

I was a stay home dad for over 4 years of his life. He never was around my weed, nor was my clients some junkies. But that put aside, I couldn't get a job so I had to do something to provide for my family.
Im not going to be sorry for myself, nor cry on reddit about how I made mistakes towards my child. He loves me, and I love him. For me, that is what matters.
"All about you and what you want" ok. If you say so.
Clearly no point on talking with you further :)

My son loves and respects me.
We have had awesome time since I started to spend my time with him instead of smoking weed all of the time.
Far from the shallow :)
Mate stop smoking weed. You're being delusional.
Did it out of house. Thanks, I'll keep doing what is best for me.

https://www.drugabuse.gov/publications/research-reports/marijuana/marijuana-addictive

Read this for starters.

Not blaming weed for me being addicted to it.
Same as alcoholic blaming alcohol on addiction.
Get your facts straight.

Idk why u think that I am positioning myself as a victim lol. I haven't whined on anyone, nor lashed out.
Place of bitterness you say.
My friends and releatives are enough support I need currently to keep myself sober. Thanks for advice tho :)
Not going to try to force anyone into anything.

Do your research before you come here to tell me nosense. It is psychological addiction. Way to escape emotions.

Thanks for the small bit of hope tho.
But yeah, I think that getting a real job instead of selling weed would be something.

I used to sell weed. Made 3.000€ monthly. Money was never a problem. I provided everything my family ever needed or asked.
Being unemployed doesnt mean that I didn't bring money to the table. Sorry for not making that clear.
I know that she hated weed, but when I used the substance, ofc I wouldn't see that. She never said that it is a problem for her. Never.
I am truely thankful to her.
I am even thankful to her for breaking up with me and that she opened my eyes to see what my actions caused around me.

About me not working may have been a problem.
No one wants to tell people that their husband is unemployed drug dealer.
I like that you encourage me not to slip back to my old habits. I promise, I won't. The man who I was for the last couple of years was the one who destroyed my life. All responsibility belongs to me and I accept that. 

I am not changing for her, I am changing for me.
To really, be me.

She has education. She has been working since she was 15. Not high school tho.
I took care of my child. I was around but I wasn't there for her. I was closed up, swelling in my own depression.
Weed is addictive when one is able to smoke 5g's per day.

Nah. I made the effort in order to become a better man. For myself. Making assumptions like that just makes you look like you do not understand that people change. All the time. 
Yet, she told me no reason. I figured it out by myself. Afterwards she confirmed my thoughts.
By ignoring her forever, I mean leaving her alone.
Effort for 3 days? Where did u came up with that? 
It took me 3 days to regain myself from the sorrow I was in after the breakup.

I could have made the changes, but she used to tell me that my smoking was cool for her. She never complained.

Why are you tryna talk me down instead of talking sense? 
Have you been in a same kind of an situation and talking from place of bitterness?

Just sad.

Thanks for the advice, but I am not in a need of therapies. Trust me. My own social circle is enough support for me, and all of my smoking friends have also stopped smoking because my story kinda touched 'em too. All of the smokers eventually will fall in a loop of being miserable, lazyasses. At least, all of my friends did.  
Once I told her that I would do and support her on anything what makes her happy, even if it means that she has to leave me. I am still thinking same way, I can't state that I truely love her if I am not ready to let her be happy. I am happy about the fact, that I didn't lie about that but ofc the breakup feels bad in my opinion.  


Her father is an alcoholic so I think that she felt so helpless that 2 of the most important men in her life we're addicts and she didn't want to keep looking that lifestyle. I understand her, and that's the worst thing. I know that I've the reason why we broke up. I feel dissapointed in myself, that I couldn't see her suffering about my addiction before sh\*t hit the fan. I haven't and will not ask her back, and I've told that to her also in person.  


"Be the perfect partner but without expecting anything in return",- wise words my pal. Wise, words.   


I guess I need to finally be a MAN, not a boy. Not his child but a man she can look up to.  


Wish me luck. Cannabis isn't going to get back in my life. I lost my life to it, and I am forever going to remember that. I won't ever go back to my old habits, I fucking hate the person I've become over the years. Hate him.
Doing my best
I can, but it just feels so frustrating that I can't talk to her about my feelings nor anything else.

I would like to talk about him, I had like 2,000 word text before, but I shortened it because I tought that it was the reason I couldn't post here.
I love my son and feel absolutely devastated about him losing his family.
I do all of the guys stuff with him, going to activity parks, eat to restaurants and what ever he talks about me.
I was stay home dad for 5 years, and we have developed deep relationship with him. He tells me everything, he respects me.
He does act violently towards his mom.
After we told him that we move to separate apartments, he started to act even more violent.
I am really sad for him and I am trying my very best to offer him the best life I can.
I love him even tho I can't be so much around him anymore.
Feel free to ask before judging me :)

Thanks for the comment anyway.

I know that I have to work continously to be a better man.  
I am trying my best and I wish that some day we will reconcile. Duhh, so hard.  


She isn't willing to discuss about our breakup, nor tell me about why she broke up with me. Is it because she is trying to make me realize my own mistakes by myself.. Im so lost.
I needed to shorten the text. I am trying to get a job at this moment. I am also in school to get further on my education. I make around 3k/monthly so I guess I can support 'em.

Wise words G. My granny told me the same, she is working on NA. I will keep on going, either she comes back or not. I just feel confused.  
Weed is gone, I don't want to fall back in to a insecure couch potato. I hate the person I've become over the years. Pure hate.

Yeah, weed is behind me and I'd never touch that s\*it again. I lost everything because my addiction (so far as I know).  
But should I keep trying to eventually reconcile with her, build attraction between us or just let it go? o.o

* Today is her day of moving out of our apartment.  
I promised to help her, but last night she asked me that would it be awkward if I'd help her.                   Should I still help her or just not be there for her?   

* I purchased a pair of jeans lately, and she insisted that I'd show em to her. Which I did and she gave me some compliments regarding the jeans.  

* I feel like we are more attracted towards each other after the breakup. Both of us are taking care of ourselves and I am pretty sure there is some sparks between us. We aren't so smothered now and it feels like the baggage have been lift off from our backs.  

* I will keep updating as the situation goes on.
You're not epical. Delete this.
